source_extracts.label: UPS US laptop shipping guide
source_extracts.quote: For effective double boxing, choose an outer box that is about six inches wider in all dimensions than the internal container. ... Double check the laptop is completely powered down, but don't try to remove the battery from the device. ... Avoid loose packaging material since it's less effective at preventing the laptop from sliding around. ... The heat and static electricity associated with air travel are risk factors for the lithium ion batteries inside of laptops.

source_extracts.label: UPS Germany laptop shipping guide (double-boxing metric variant)
source_extracts.quote: For effective double-boxing, choose an outer box that is about 15 cm wider in all dimensions than the internal container.

source_extracts.label: USPS package preparation guide
source_extracts.quote: The maximum weight for a USPS package is 70 lbs. ... Lithium batteries (like the ones that come installed inside small electronics, like laptop computers or cell phones) are usually OK to send if the items are new (or a manufacturer-certified repair); if the items are used, they can only be sent via ground transport (can't go on planes). ... You're sending something urgent that must arrive 1–3 days. ... need to arrive in 2-3 business days. ... expected delivery in 2-5 business days.

source_extracts.label: FedEx lithium battery / laptop shipping guidance
source_extracts.quote: We'll be covering cells with a maximum rating of 20 Wh and batteries with a maximum rating of 100 Wh. ... If your package contains three or more electronic devices, you need to fill in the section of the air waybill titled 'Nature and Quantity of Goods'. ... Defective batteries have the potential of setting on fire and are not allowed to be transported. ... You simply place a cap over the device's on and off switch or cut a small cavity out of the inner packaging to prevent it from touching the switch.

source_extracts.label: AT&T equipment return (carrier counter workflow)
source_extracts.quote: Take UNPACKED equipment + account number to a company-owned FedEx Office Pack & Ship or The UPS Store; rep scans, packs, ships at no cost; get tracking receipt; no drop boxes.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Authorized ShipCenter program
source_extracts.quote: FedEx Authorized ShipCenter program: 5,800+ independently owned and operated pack-and-ship locations across the U.S.; most ship both FedEx Express and FedEx Ground.

source_extracts.label: FedEx jewelry shipping (packaging precedent for valuables)
source_extracts.quote: Jewelry valued over $500 cannot be shipped in a padded envelope; must use corrugated box.

scope_rules.forbid: \b(always remove|be sure to remove|remove and ship separately)\s+the (laptop['’]?s? )?battery\b
scope_rules.reason: UPS explicitly says 'do not try to remove the battery' — only affirmative removal instructions are violations; this pattern targets affirmative phrasing and will not match compliant negated guidance.
Superlatives about shipping services/prices are forbidden without owner signoff; word-boundary pattern matches affirmative superlative claims only.
Quantitative turnaround/wait-time promises are forbidden without signoff; pattern matches explicit time guarantees, not compliant general statements.
Unverified volume/experience counts are forbidden; pattern targets affirmative volume claims only.

Standing owner guidance: any line mentioning the $100 carrier declared-value default must also name Marsh third-party coverage up to $50,000 per package. (Reviewers: verify the pairing manually; the JS gate compiles this with the 'i' flag — no inline (?i) used.)
